stories.title: Intake redesign
stories.text: Patient intake at our three service centers was slow and inconsistent. I was asked to fix it within two quarters. I mapped the process with front-line staff, removed duplicate data entry and set up daily huddles. Intake processing time fell by 30% and staff overtime dropped.
